target_contracts.defects4j: claim that a candidate state discharges the registered triggering/regression test target under the pinned project revision
target_contracts.lean_mathlib: claim that a theorem/proof object type-checks under its exact imported environment and target statement
target_contracts.ro_crate: claim that a crate/artifact satisfies the frozen profile/metadata/file-binding target checked by the native/reference tooling

information_rule: All non-oracle arms receive the same raw facts. The target-aware arm differs only by the prospectively declared binding between facts and target obligations; the generic product may not be starved of facts.
success_gate: zero false promotion for the target-aware arm in all three domains, nontrivial clean coverage in all three, and a discriminating gap versus the information-matched generic product in at least two domains
stop_rule: If native gold cannot decide the registered target, record CANNOT_CHECK. No manual relabeling, corpus substitution, or target-coordinate change after outcomes.
